items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] … Jimmy Owens, Dick Hurwitz on trumpet, and Morty Bullman on trombone.

ctx.x: Yeah, Bob left after a couple of months and he was replaced by Wilbur Bascomb, who worked he rest of the show.
… Jimmy Owens, Dick Hurwitz on trumpet, and Morty Bullman on trombone.
Morty Bullman was a very fine trombonist who worked with the Arthur Godfrey Show, had done all these things. He was Carmine Caruso’s first brass student, okay? This was in the early 50’s.
